propositions: Each attempted fallback candidate must emit exactly one rebar OTel span with zero-based order, model identity, outcome (returned/raised), and optional usage, without duplication from Agent instrumentation.
Candidate spans must nest as children beneath the single Agent model-request span via ambient OTel context, not as sibling parallel traces.
A raised candidate span reason must be sanitized through sanitize_diagnostic and contain no prompt, response, credential, endpoint, or unsanitized exception body.
The S2-preserved native-to-prompted fallback (bug-895c) must remain legible as native-attempt raised span followed by prompted-attempt returned span with no _pai_structured control-flow change.
Span emission or exporter failures while tracing is enabled must be swallowed at the wrapper boundary, leaving fallback result, RunUsage, and exception identical to tracing-off.
The base install without tracing extra imports must run with no span dependency error and produce identical result, usage, and exception behavior as the instrumented variant.
